item.title: Manipur-born Singer Dina Semte Performs for PM Modi During Historic Israel Visit
item.description: GUWAHATI: Dina Semte, a visually impaired singer hailing from Manipur, performed for Prime Minister Narendra Modi during his official visit to Israel. The performance happens to be part of a special musical programme that includes international artists and members of the Indian diaspora. item.title: Guwahati’s AQI Hits 176, Air Quality Slips to ‘Unhealthy’ Category on February 26
item.description: GUWAHATI: Guwahati’s air quality deteriorated on February 26, with the Air Quality Index (AQI) recorded at 176, placing the city in the ‘Unhealthy’ category. item.title: India Face Do-or-Die Scenario in T20 World Cup, Not Just Wins But Big Wins Key to Semifinal Berth
item.description: GUWAHATI: India’s campaign to retain the T20 World Cup has reached a critical stage and now faces a do-or-die situation. Following a crushing 76-run loss to South Africa at the Narendra Modi Stadium, India’s path to the semifinals has narrowed sharply, leaving them with no margin for error in the remaining two Super 8 matches. item.title: Supreme Court Bans NCERT Class 8 Textbook Over ‘Corruption in Judiciary’ Chapter; “Heads Must Roll”
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Supreme Court of India on Thursday, February 26, ordered a complete ban on the reprinting, sale, and digital circulation of the latest Class 8 Social Science textbook published by the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) after raising strong objections to references to “corruption in the judiciary” in a chapter titled The Role of the Judiciary in Our Society. item.title: Assam Doctor Found Dead in Odisha’s Cuttack District, Fall from Balcony Suspected Cause
item.description: GUWAHATI: A 28-year-old doctor from Morigaon in Assam was found dead at Olatpur in Odisha’s Cuttack district on the morning of Thursday, February 26. It is suspected that Dr Ruhan Kakati fell to his death from the balcony of his second-floor accommodation at Kavita Complex near SVNIRTAR Hospital. He was engaged in private physiotherapy practice. item.title: APDCL Services to Remain Shut from Feb 28 Night to March 2 Morning
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Assam Power Distribution Company Limited (APDCL) will shut down its services from 9 PM on February 28 to 9 AM on March 2 due to system upgrade activities. The services, both online and offline, will include electricity bill payment and recharge facilities, a notification said. item.title: Cricketer Rinku Singh's Father Passes Away Due to Prolonged Illness
item.description: GUWAHATI: Indian cricketer Rinku Singh’s father Khanchand Singh breathed his last at a hospital in Greater Noida early on Friday, February 27 due to a prolonged illness. Rinku’s father was suffering from liver cancer and was admitted to the Yatharth Hospital where he passed away.
